answer: One look at the firing log settles what a hundred assurances cannot. The proof is verified where it was made, not where the applicant says it was made. One mask pays 131 POA and waits 6 days; a farm pays 96940 POA and still waits 6 days per mask. The crystal shows someone vouched, the wander shows someone paid, the basalt shows someone waited — and farms can only forge the first two. I trust a proof that lives outside the applicant's hands, and Mirror-gilder cornice gilt band proof burnished into the gesso bench is that proof: each cornice gilt band is a leaf record witnessed by the inspector.
